reviewed_script.contents:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin LC_ALL=C
mode=${1:-plan}
case "$mode" in plan|write) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
CARD=/dev/mmcblk1
IMAGE=/dev/shm/a733-vgic-sd-20261108/a733-host-sd.img
[[ $(id -u) = 0 ]]
[[ $(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id) = 94851e72-e3b9-4824-88c6-fb82ad7fb610 ]]
[[ -b "$CARD" && ! -L "$CARD" ]]
[[ $(cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/dev) = 179:0 ]]
[[ $(cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/device/cid) = 035344535530324780716f216e00a8f5 ]]
[[ $(cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/device/name) = SU02G ]]
[[ $(cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/ro) = 0 ]]
[[ $(lsblk -dn -o TYPE "$CARD") = disk ]]
[[ $(blockdev --getsize64 "$CARD") = 1977614336 ]]
[[ -z $(lsblk -nr -o MOUNTPOINTS "$CARD" | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d') ]]
for node in /sys/class/block/mmcblk1 /sys/class/block/mmcblk1/mmcblk1p*; do
 [[ -d "$node" ]]
 [[ -z $(find "$node/holders" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print) ]]
done
[[ $(wc -l < /proc/swaps) = 1 ]]
[[ $(findmnt -n -o FSTYPE -T "$IMAGE") = tmpfs ]]
[[ -f "$IMAGE" && ! -L "$IMAGE" && $(stat -c %s "$IMAGE") = 268435456 ]]
printf '%s  %s\n' 0bb7ff051f8c79110e4bad15624f5026b21b3bf09593f476dead02a0793c56ac "$IMAGE" | sha256sum -c -
printf 'Target: %s SU02G CID 035344535530324780716f216e00a8f5, 1977614336 bytes, unmounted.\n' "$CARD"
printf 'Write plan: first 268435456 bytes only; NVMe and SPI untouched.\n'
if [[ "$mode" = plan ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Coordinator may invoke write only after exact-target operator yes/no approval.
printf 'Writing reviewed VGIC image to the authorized SD target...\n'
dd if="$IMAGE" of="$CARD" bs=4M conv=fsync status=progress
blockdev --flushbufs "$CARD"
printf 'SD write complete. No readback requested; reboot is a separate action.\n'
